prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: photographic hero asset for a contemporary Pakistani restaurant website, not a UI mockup.
Primary request: Premium editorial food photography of a contemporary Pakistani shared dinner. An oversized round well-used hammered and engraved metal karahi filled with realistic tomato-based chicken karahi with fresh julienned ginger, green chillies and coriander. Torn blistered naan at lower left, a small raita bowl, and a brushed metal serving spoon.
Scene/backdrop: Parchment table with a narrow muted saffron and burnt clay woven textile at the edge, deep aubergine background shadows.
Composition/framing: Landscape 3:2 photograph, cropped close at an oblique overhead angle. Food occupies most of the frame. A generous meal rather than a catering spread.
Lighting/mood: Warm natural window light, tactile food, premium editorial realism.
Constraints: No text, no logos, no people, no floating objects, no gratuitous ethnic ornaments.
